outcomes.b: Decided over the fits' evaluations, but not among the settings that differ only in the calyx, or not on every split (about 2 in 5): E143's reading stands for the other views too.
outcomes.c: No view at the claws or the somata is decided on every split (about 1 in 6): megamat's calyx stages decide nothing under any reading.
outcomes.d: The claws' cost is the read half's (about 9 in 10, beside the others): the classes stand as scored; how the claws enter a class goes to Tom and Yang.
outcomes.e: Without the boutons the megamat stage error still orders the settings (about 4 in 5, beside the others).
outcomes.f: An identity or a read-once check fails in a cell (about 1 in 5, beside the others): that cell is read by E136's own reading on fewer splits.

judgments: An evaluation's value at a stage is the error of its four searched wirings' mean views (hal's wirings_as_flies, row 'common'), as the fits' loss and E136's rescore read it; the planner's probe reproduces on that reading (checked in step 0). Each wiring's value is kept beside. The settings are read as E143 reads them: the mean over T of each wiring's error.

The probe counted every evaluation (A1's 124, F's 126); the lock's definitions leave out an evaluation whose rates were not held on every searched wiring and count it (A1: 4, F: 2), so step 0 reproduces the probe on every evaluation and every later part reads the held ones.

L2 and 'over all views' at the PN dendrites read four views with the matrix (E134's lock, E136's measure 'all', error_with_matrix); the claws and somata have three. The probe's L2 consistencies reproduce on that reading.

A loss's term is a stage's population error over the term's views (the root mean square of the views' errors); a loss is the root mean square of its terms, so L0, L1 and L2 are E136's measures 'strength', 'strength_sharing' and 'all'.
A pick is among the held evaluations; its regret's start is evaluation 0 (the family at z = 0 on the searched wirings) and the other half's lowest is over the held evaluations.

Megamat's part of "holds" reads changes from evaluation 0 on the 'common' reading against the half, with E136's spreads as scored (classes.json 'spreads' for strength, beside.spreads_all_views for all views) and 0.040 as the bar (the entry's "the control fit's 0.040", E147's CONTROL_FALL; the control fit's fall is 0.0403, beside), as the probe reads it: with 0.0403 A1's evaluation 9 (a fall of 0.04026 against half b) would not count. The probe's 429 claws worse of 456 against half a reproduces with the claws' spread rounded to 0.017 (W's evaluation 113 at a change of 0.01686); the lock reads the spread as scored (0.01669), 430.

The read-once check in a cell is E143's: on E136's split, against each half, the read-once megamat stage error on strength at the cell's evaluation 0 and at its pick (the fit's best evaluation) within CHECK_TOL of E136's own reading of the same runs; the largest difference over every evaluation, per stage and view, is given beside.

'Every split' of a view's consistency at a stage is that stage's splits (E143's stage_splits: 35, 10, 3, 3); a loss's consistency reads E143's 200 joint splits, which decide, with E136's split beside (as E143's tells-apart).

A view's spread is the SD over the family's eight wirings of its per-wiring error on that view against all the stage's flies (read once); a set's range is the largest minus the smallest of its models' errors on that view against all the stage's flies.

"Megamat reads the calyx beside strength" needs one stage and view (claws or somata, sharing or breadth) decided on every set it names: each of the four cells' held evaluations, both pooled sets and the nine settings at pn_inhadd 1000.

The classed points' claws (design 6, the claws' class) are E136's per-wiring comparison (`compare`) of the cell's classed point with the family on the cell's four read wirings, against each half of E136's split, with E136's kc_claw spread on strength; a single claw fly as the reference likewise. "One fly's": one claw fly alone gives the sign in all four cells and no other claw fly alone does.
Without the boutons (L4) the settings are E143's settings without E135's four arms (E135 set their PN stages from the dendrite flies); with them beside.
No view's reading is weighted by its reliability; no entry is dropped (validation2 and E138's readings are not used).
